mapper.insert: insert into notes (user_id, title, content, created_at, updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select note_id, user_id, title, content, created_at, updated_at from notes where user_id = #{userId} order by updated_at desc, created_at desc
mapper.update: update notes set title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = now() where note_id = #{noteId} and user_id = #{userId}
